culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Arimasa Dobashi. While 'disinfecting' the area, he had plenty of time to study the special climatic peculiarities of the lake, including the directions the wind would take, and its property to send any boats towards the island. After showing himself to Ran and Conan at the lake's edge when the fog hit the area, he used a motorboat he had prepared beforehand to get to the island and prepare his ambush. He wanted to make it looks like Ryo tried to kill Reina, then kill Kogoro before killing herself.

motive.quote: Because of that, her daughter was trying to kill herself the next day.

motive.zhHans: 因此，她的女儿在第二天试图自杀。Reina 得知了 Dobashi 女儿自杀未遂的事，并连续三天前往医院探望她，而这一切 Dobashi 都因一心复仇而错过了。
motive.en: Because of that, her daughter was trying to kill herself the next day. Reina had learned about Dobashi's daughter suicide attempt and has visited her in the hospital for three days, something Dobashi had missed in his single-minded lust for revenge.

method.zhHans: 在雾气笼罩该区域时，于湖边现身让兰和柯南看到之后，他乘坐事先准备好的摩托艇登上小岛，布置好埋伏。
method.en: After showing himself to Ran and Conan at the lake's edge when the fog hit the area, he used a motorboat he had prepared beforehand to get to the island and prepare his ambush.

evidence.zhHans: 还揭示出小五郎锻炼的最终动机，是成为冲野洋子的保镖。
evidence.en: It is also revealed that Kogoro's ultimate motive for his training was to become a bodyguard for Yoko Okino.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Arimasa Dobashi。在“消毒”该区域期间，他有充足的时间研究湖面特殊的气候特性，包括风的走向，以及会把任何船只推向小岛的特性。在雾气笼罩该区域时，于湖边现身让兰和柯南看到之后，他乘坐事先准备好的摩托艇登上小岛，布置好埋伏。他想伪装成 Ryo 试图杀害 Reina，然后再杀死小五郎，最后自杀。
resolution.en: The culprit is Arimasa Dobashi. While 'disinfecting' the area, he had plenty of time to study the special climatic peculiarities of the lake, including the directions the wind would take, and its property to send any boats towards the island. After showing himself to Ran and Conan at the lake's edge when the fog hit the area, he used a motorboat he had prepared beforehand to get to the island and prepare his ambush. He wanted to make it looks like Ryo tried to kill Reina, then kill Kogoro before killing herself.

summary.en:
It started when Kogoro is doing a training to become a bodyguard, but he failed. He then asks Arimasa Dobashi, the security guard representative, to give him one more chance.

Attempted Murder (Past)

Location: Street

suspects: Reina Sawazaki, Kazuya Kusumoto, Hideo Isogawa, Kenzo Kushizaki, Chisato Arimura, and Arimasa Dobashi
